pages.text: [#](53341a)Sleep is not passive, and the spirit world is not a waiting room. A Dream Catcher placed near the sleeping body shapes what happens when consciousness crosses the boundary and returns.[#]() [#](53341a)Different weavings give different effects on waking.[#]()
pages.title: Dream Weavers

pages.text: [#](53341a)Only one catcher near you takes effect — choose deliberately.[#]()
[#](53341a)The old quickness weaving: Item Frame, Fanciful Thread, feathers, Diamond Vapour, Tormented Twine, and long swiftness/slowness splash potions.[#]()
[#](53341a)The same weave frame, but swaps in long strength and weakness splash potions.[#]()
[#](53341a)A long poison splash potion and Mellifluous Hunger in the opposing potion slot.[#]()
[#](53341a)The harsher Tormented Twine frame, woven with Diamond Vapour and long poison/night-vision splash potions.[#]()
[#](53341a)Keeps the old frame but binds Brew of Flowing Spirit against Brew of Sleeping.[#]()
